producer_preflight_notes.pose_read: The six slots read as guard, anticipation, half-extension, full contact, recoil and returned guard. J01/J06 intentionally share the guard state; the in-between poses remain distinct.
producer_preflight_notes.anatomy_and_equipment: Shoulder-to-glove and hand-to-cane paths appear connected at overview size; this remains pending frame-by-frame independent review at native size and nearest-neighbor 4×.
producer_preflight_notes.morphology_and_identity: The sheet reads as a slim adult with gray hair, glasses, burgundy cravat and teal coat; exact likeness and style fidelity remain pending owner review.
producer_preflight_notes.pixel_finish: The RGB count and nonuniform background block any claim of native pixel-art cleanliness or SMS palette compliance.

required_next_actions: Resolve the nonuniform background without modifying character pixels, or regenerate and remeasure the complete sheet.
Freeze a true six-frame grid with no clipped body part, cane, pommel or tip.
Review all poses at intended 80×80 native scale and nearest-neighbor 4× before palette conversion.
